mechanics.claim: Zed becomes untargetable during the cast delay and dash, and cannot cast Death Mark's detonation damage until the mark duration ends.
mechanics.quote: '''Zed''' becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and, after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, he {{tip|dashes}} to 125 units beyond the target enemy champion

mechanics.claim: During Marked for Death, Zed stores a portion of all pre-mitigation physical and magic damage he and his Shadows deal to the target, which detonates at the end of the duration as physical damage.
mechanics.quote: '''Zed''' stores a portion of all {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} {{as|physical damage}} and {{as|magic damage}} he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' deal to the target, detonating at the end of the duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Death Mark does not store true damage despite storing physical and magic damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Death Mark's'' stored damage derives from all [[basic attack]]s, [[Champion ability|abilities]], [[item]]s, [[Runes Reforged|runes]] and [[buff]]s.

mechanics.claim: The Shadow spawned by Death Mark can mimic Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash regardless of range, adding extra damage instances against the target while marked.
mechanics.quote: which is able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range

mechanics.claim: Zed is ordered to basic attack his target immediately after reappearing from the dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Zed''' will be ordered to basic attack his target after reappearing.

mechanics.claim: Zed gains ghosting for the duration of the mark, a mobility effect not a damage/defense effect.
Spell shield only blocks the mark's application, not the cast or the detonation of an already-applied mark.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the {{as|mark's|buzzword}} application. They will not prevent '''Zed''' from initiating ''Death Mark'' against the target nor block the detonation from a {{as|mark|buzzword}} that is already applied.

mechanics.claim: Death Mark's cooldown starts on cast.
